#!/bin/bash
# A sample of the stacks of the process that grows the 10M index, 10 seconds
# every 30 minutes, with /usr/bin/sample at 10 ms between samples
# (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index, "Vigilancia de la corrida del
# 10M"). It sends the process no signal; sample suspends it for an instant at
# every sample, and the stretch it falls in is marked from samples.log.
# Usage: sampler.sh <pid>
set -u
M=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/grow10m/mon
PID=$1
while ps -p $PID > /dev/null 2>&1; do
  at=$(date +%H%M%S)
  echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') start sample-$at" >> $M/samples.log
  /usr/bin/sample $PID 10 10 -file $M/sample-$at.txt >> $M/sampler.out 2>&1
  echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') end sample-$at exit $?" >> $M/samples.log
  sleep 1785
done
echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') the process is gone" >> $M/samples.log
